review_type: Hardening deviation: clear firmware descriptor slot after vmalloc failure

finding.root_cause: Stock frees the descriptor after vmalloc failure but leaves cdev+0xc58 pointing to freed memory. Repeated writes to the registered tp_self_test proc entry invoke tp_alloc_tp_firmware_data(0x100000) again.
finding.reachability_evidence: Round 16 review: proc_create("tp_self_test", 436, ...) with proc_ops_tp_self_test.proc_write=tp_self_test_write; Ghidra xref at 0010cc74; handler returns -ENOMEM without cleanup.
finding.stock_behavior: Confirmed in Ghidra, P-Code and stock AArch64. Preserved on reconstruction/zte-tpd-syna-release-attested.

change.code: Set *(struct tpd_firmware_data **)(cdev + 0xc58) = NULL before kfree(fw_data) on the vmalloc-failure path.
change.compiled_instruction: str xzr, [x21, #0xc58] at candidate offset 0xc200 immediately before kfree at 0xc204.
change.behavior_scope: Fixes sequential retry after vmalloc failure. No locking/refcounting was added; concurrent writers remain outside this narrow change.

joern.disposition: The broad call-level alerts remain; control-flow review confirms the failure path now clears the published pointer before freeing the descriptor.

mapping.stock_offline_exact_claim: Retained only on the parent reconstruction branch.
mapping.current_branch_claim: Build and strict static analysis pass; this function intentionally differs from stock.

verification.microtask_exact_gate: Not run; its allowed statuses require offline-exact parity, which this branch intentionally changes.
verification.host_harness: Not run; the existing harness asserts stock dangling-slot behavior and is bound to the old source hash.

limitations: The patch covers sequential retry; no synchronization was added for concurrent proc writers or concurrent firmware consumers.
No dynamic ASan/UBSan retry case was run, and the prior stock harness is not valid evidence for the hardened source.
The change intentionally invalidates function-level OFFLINE_EXACT equivalence on this branch.
Android runtime, actual memory-pressure injection and NX809J hardware were not exercised.
